action: Advance exactly one checkpoint stage with operator continue --steps 1.
basis: Story stage can generate a draft, perform at most one bounded length repair, then run an independent script review. The built-in story preflight requires at least nine unused Gemini calls for story plus voice headroom.
constraints: Use only the existing gateway-managed free-tier configuration; no paid fallback.
Stop after story and inspect exact narration, fact-to-scene mapping, reviewer result, and ledger.
Do not proceed to voice/TTS without a separate plan after verifying external and internal free usage limits.
stop_conditions: Stop if any additional search, download, metadata, source fetch, TTS, or render call occurs.
Stop if cumulative Gemini calls exceed nine or any call is failed/unknown.
Do not retry, restart, or create another job if the stage is failed, deferred, unknown, or needs_attention.
